name: Prague University of Economics and Business
summary: Economics and business university in Prague's Žižkov, founded 1953; 8 English bachelor's chosen by interview, essay or online test, not grades.

ib.text: No IB points minimum: each programme selects by its own interview, essay and video, or Scio GAP test. VŠE assesses your diploma itself, with no extra fee for English-taught programmes.

dates.label: Finance and Accounting online open house day
Scio GAP online test, Round I (other date: 20 March)
Scio GAP online test, Round II (other date: 22 May)
International Business: certified hard copies of your diploma due at VŠE

programmes.name: Finance and Accounting
programmes.about: Financial and management accounting, taxation, corporate finance, financial economics and business law, with a corporate project or internship. Accredited by ACCA, with exam exemptions towards its Higher Diploma. First intake September 2027.
programmes.ib: No grade minimum: a motivation letter with CV, then an online interview in English; an English certificate is optional.
programmes.selectionNote: Motivation letter and CV on the faculty's template; complete applications are invited to an online MS Teams interview on the letter and basic economics.
programmes.closesNote: Later rounds close 28 Feb and 30 Apr 2027

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.about: International business, economics, entrepreneurship, logistics and supply chains, world economy and languages, with an optional third-year double degree at the University of Vaasa (Finland) or OTH Regensburg (Germany).
programmes.ib: Grades and English certificates do not count: one online interview on motivation and English decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Online MS Teams interview in March: 50 points motivation, 50 English, at least 25 in each plus the Dean's total. The five topics are published in advance.
programmes.closesNote: Second round to 30 April only if places remain

programmes.name: International and Diplomatic Studies
programmes.about: International politics, economics and law, comparative politics, diplomatic history and diplomatic practice, with a strong EU focus and quantitative methods including calculus.
programmes.ib: Grades do not count: one online interview on international affairs, your motivation and your English decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview: 50 points for knowledge and motivation, 50 for English, at least 25 in each; ranked on the total.
programmes.closesNote: Second round to 30 April only if places remain

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Management-focused business degree: microeconomics, macroeconomics, maths, statistics and law first, then strategy, operations, corporate finance, marketing and entrepreneurship, taught largely through case studies.
programmes.ib: No grade minimum: an essay, a motivation video and an interview decide.
programmes.selectionNote: An essay of 1,000–1,200 words in English on a set topic and a 1–3 minute motivation video, uploaded with the application; then an interview on site or online.

programmes.name: Economics of Markets and Organizations
programmes.about: How markets, competition and industry structures work, taught jointly with the CERGE-EI economics institute (40% of teaching) and aimed at strategy in business and public policy.
programmes.ib: No grade minimum: an essay, a motivation video and an interview decide.
programmes.selectionNote: An essay of 1,000–1,200 words in English on a set topic and a 1–3 minute motivation video, then a short interview in Prague or online.
programmes.closesNote: 2nd intake to 30 April; 3rd to 10 June if places remain

programmes.name: Economic Data Science
programmes.about: Statistics, econometrics and data analysis applied to economic questions, preparing you to analyse and interpret economic data, with an optional study-abroad period in the second or third year.
programmes.ib: The Scio GAP online test and your CV decide; B2 English proof, which English-taught secondary schooling covers.
programmes.selectionNote: Scio General Academic Prerequisites test online (80%) plus a CV on the faculty's template (20%); one test attempt per application year.
programmes.closesNote: Round II, advised for EU students, closes 30 April

programmes.name: Business Information Systems and Computer Science
programmes.about: IT and business together: information systems, web and mobile development, databases and cloud, data, AI and cybersecurity, with a specialisation in data management, innovation or data science. First intake September 2027.
programmes.ib: The Scio GAP online test and your CV decide; B2 English proof, which English-taught secondary schooling covers.
programmes.selectionNote: Scio General Academic Prerequisites test online (80%) plus a CV on the faculty's template (20%); one test attempt per application year.
programmes.closesNote: Round II, advised for EU students, closes 30 April

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.about: Economics with law and other social sciences, weighted towards international economics and politics; taught in English since 2012/13 to students from 24 countries.
programmes.ib: No grade minimum: an essay, a motivation video and a CV are scored, and 70 points admits.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. A two-page essay on a topic you choose, a 2-minute motivation video and a CV; 70 points admits.

lastYear.text: two rounds, in late February and late April

separateFrom.name: Economics of Markets and Organizations
separateFrom.reason: A different degree at a different faculty (Faculty of Economics), with its own essay, video and CV selection and a 70-point admission line.

notes: Each application costs €100 and is not refunded; tuition for students starting in September 2027 is €6,000 a year, paid by semester.
Czech law accepts the IB Diploma without nostrification (Act 111/1998, § 48(4)(c)); if a programme page asks you to nostrify, ask the office to assess your IB Diploma instead.
Send certified paper copies of your diploma by post once you have it: an uploaded scan alone does not complete enrolment.
